riskPerTradeBps.help: Most you can lose on one trade, in basis points of equity (100 = 1%).

maxAssetBps.help: Largest position in one asset, in basis points of equity (2500 = 25%).

maxExposureBps.help: Total value of all open positions, in basis points of equity.

minOrderUsdt.help: Smallest order worth placing, in USDT (Binance rejects tiny orders).

maxTradesPerDay.help: New entries allowed per UTC day.

dailyLossLimitBps.help: Stop new orders for the UTC day after losing this much of start-of-day equity (200 = 2%).

dailyLossWarnPct.help: Warn when this share of the daily loss limit is used.

maxDrawdownBps.help: Close everything and require a PIN restart when equity falls this far below its high-water mark (1500 = 15%).

minConfidence.help: Lowest AI confidence that can become an order. Low is always log-only.

minRewardToRisk.help: Target distance divided by stop distance must be at least this.

stopAtrMin.help: Stop must be at least this many ATRs from entry.

stopAtrMax.help: Stop must be at most this many ATRs from entry.

maxEntryDeviationBps.help: Entry must be within this distance of the current price (30 = 0.3%).

maxSignalAgeMin.help: Signals older than this are discarded.

maxSnapshotAgeMin.help: The snapshot behind a signal must be at most this old.

feedDisagreementBps.help: Pause signals when the two price feeds differ by more than this (50 = 0.5%).

feedStaleSeconds.help: A feed with no data for this long is stale.

feedResumeSeconds.help: Feeds must agree for this long before signals resume.
